Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Papers, Please Day 1 - Arstotzka border checkpoint at Grestin. Rule: ARSTOTZKA citizens APPROVED, all foreigners DENIED.

CONTROLS LEARNED (corrected coordinates using 1140x640 pixel normalization): Pause menu accessed via Escape key. RESUME button at (0.497, 0.75), MAIN MENU at (0.497, 0.828), QUIT at (0.497, 0.906). Game features overhead desk view for checkpoint operations.

DOCUMENT HANDLING: Documents appear at bottom left intake area around pixel (100, 490) = (0.088, 0.766). 'DRAG DOCUMENTS HERE' text marks center inspection zone around (0.4, 0.7). Processed documents returned by dragging to bottom left area around (0.1, 0.92). Successfully cleared stuck documents using this return mechanism.

PROCESSED ENTRANTS:
- Entrant 1 (Tuirvoiska/Lumina): ARSTOTZKA citizen incorrectly stamped DENIED. M.O.A. CITATION issued: 'Protocol Violated. Applicant clear for entry' - WARNING, no penalty for first violation. Citation window persists on right side of screen at pixel ~(747, 520).
- Entrant 2 (Mitrovic/Mikrovin Zoran): IMPOR (foreign) correctly stamped DENIED.
- Entrant 3 (Liepins, Arturs): REPUBLIA (foreign) correctly stamped DENIED. DOB 1958.11.23, SEX M, ISS Lesrenadi, EXP 1983.05.03, ID 2C1L9-G9FHG. This document reappeared after being processed.

TECHNICAL ISSUES: Earlier coordinate estimates were incorrect, causing multiple failed interactions. Corrected by calculating normalized coordinates from actual pixel positions (x/1140, y/640). Encountered stuck documents (BOVIN entry visa dated 1982.11.23 with ENTRY DENIED stamp, later the Liepins document) that required clearing via drag to return area. Experienced issues with entrants 4-10+ featuring blue/teal skin character models that failed to present documents.

CURRENT STATUS: Just returned the Liepins, Arturs document (already stamped ENTRY DENIED) to the return area. M.O.A. CITATION window still visible on right side. Time showed 58 K$ in recent view. Desk should now be clear. Next step: call next entrant to continue processing.
